title: Emitter once
skill: Name the class and every listener rule

good: In src/events/emitter.js, class Emitter has three bugs. emit() loops over the live listener array, so a listener that removes itself (or a once() listener) makes the next one skip. once() calls fn before it removes itself, so a re-emit inside fn runs it twice. off(event, fn) cannot remove a once() listener because only the wrapper is stored. Rules: emit() calls a copy of the list taken when emit starts, in order (a listener removed during emit still runs this time); once() removes the wrapper first, then calls fn, and stores fn on the wrapper; off() also matches that stored fn. Only change that file. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
lazy: Some event listeners don't fire. Fix the emitter.
